command.name: SRFS
command.title: Select Server Features
command.description:
Reconfigures a single command by changing feature flags and/or switching command versions.
See the section on "feature versioning" for details.
Servers may not allow any changes to be made. The command should still be implemented as a placeholder always indicating an error (`ERR`) status in that case.
Changing versions may reset feature flags to the command version's default. If version and feature changes are requested in the same command, servers should first (preliminarily) change command version to update features before applying any requested changes to them
If mandatory feature flag changes are being requested, any unsupported/failed change should fail the whole command without further side-effects, neither version nor feature selection must be (partially) changed in that case. Clients are recommended to request conditional feature changes to ease implementation unless exact feature selection is essential for client operations.
Servers should never punish clients for errors caused by legit `SRFS` requests.
Clients are recommended to check `SRLC` before using this command and verify actual features by requesting `SRLC` again after all `SRFS` requests have been completed.
`SRLC` and `SRFS` should not be used simultaneously to avoid inconsistent/outdated information but multiple `SRFS` commands may be issued in parallel.

parameters.parameter: requested command version (using currently active version must not reset feature flags)

subparameters.condition: can be omitted if no feature flags should be changed
subparameters.parameter:
change of flag, consisting of: (concatenated without space)
1. requested state of feature flag: * `+` to enable the feature flag (mandatory - will fail command if not possible) * `-` to disable the feature flag (mandatory - will fail command if not possible) * `*` to conditionally request a feature flag to be enabled, if possible (optional - actual result must be checked via `SRLC`) * `/` to conditionally request a feature flag to be disabled, if possible (optional - actual result must be checked via `SRLC`) 2. name of feature flag to change

responses.response:
status
* if requested command version and changes to feature flags are effective from now on: `ACK` * if any requested change is not supported/possible: `ERR`

example.server: -ERR AAAA 811 "seed" feature is unavailable on this server
+ACK AAAA 867note that channel stays open; reconfiguration could not be finished instantly
-ERR AAAA 982the requested change actually fails after a short time

notes.note: Do not mistake channel acknowledgement for a success indicator: As with all other commands, `SRFS` has only finished successfully once the channel was closed without any error indication.
